title: Mint Ribbon Uniform Costume
prompt: An original young woman with long, straight black hair and wispy bangs smiles brightly with her head tilted. She wears a white and mint ruffled costume with ribbon ties at the shoulders and waist, a mint cap with white cross details and lace trim, and a mint choker. Her hands are clasped near her chest. A pale wood-panel backdrop with soft, even light. Palette of mint, white, and soft pink skin. Sweet and playful, in the style of a cheerful costume-cosplay photo.
workingNotes:
- The mint ribbons and cap are the signature details.
- Keep the warm, open smile for a friendly tone.
tryThis: Try this: Keep a warm, open smile.
